row: The Surgical Vet By Dr. Ashutosh Tiwari

Welcome to The Surgical Vet by Dr. Ashutosh Tiwari!
I am a veterinarian dedicated to sharing practical surgical knowledge, clinical tips, case studies, field techniques, and real-life veterinary skills for students, practitioners, and animal lovers.

Here you will find:
🔹 Small & Large Animal Surgery
🔹 Field Condition Protocols
🔹 Emergency Procedures
🔹 Diagnostic Techniques
🔹 Orthopedics & Soft Tissue Surgery
🔹 Real Case Discussions & Clinical Guidance
🔹 Lab Animal Consultation & Research Tips

My goal is to make veterinary surgery simple, scientific, and skill-based, so that every vet can perform confidently in clinics and field conditions.

Join me in this journey of learning, surgery, and saving lives.
📌 Subscribe for daily practical veterinary videos.
